title: Pillow TIFF saving can disclose process memory or corrupt the heap
summary: Untrusted image metadata can override encoder geometry when saving TIFF through libtiff. Saved output can contain process memory; Predictor=2 can instead cause heap corruption and a crash. Code execution is not established.

severity.rationale: The documented paths require TIFF output through libtiff and particular metadata handling or a crafted palette TIFF. Service memory disclosure and crashes warrant a 30-day response.

affected.note: The advisory lists versions through 12.3.0 as affected.

exposure: Image conversion tools are exposed when they preserve untrusted EXIF or tiffinfo, or re-save crafted palette TIFFs with inherited compression.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Upgrades can require compatibility changes and service restarts.

verification: Confirm the runtime uses the patched Pillow release; test TIFF conversion with representative inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
